title: High-order parametric local discontinuous Galerkin methods for anisotropic curve-shortening flows
summary: We propose a family of high-order local discontinuous Galerkin (LDG) methods, built on a parametric representation and coupled with a semi-implicit backward Euler time discretization, for isotropic and anisotropic curve-shortening flows. The spatial LDG formulation introduces auxiliary variables and carefully designed numerical fluxes which inherit the underlying variational structure. We prove the unconditional energy dissipation for the semi-discrete scheme, and establish the well-posedness for the fully discrete scheme under mild assumptions.
